lines.text: The Network thanks you! The Network will now renew your contract!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Choose your broadcast! Short and sweet, or long and sour!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Pick a package! Any package! Not that one! Okay, that one!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Marathon! The ratings love a marathon! The contestants less so!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: It's SWEEPS WEEK! New rules! Same floor!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Sweeps! The ratings are watching! So is something else!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Special episode tonight! Very special! Extra special! Different!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Mystery! What could it be! Even I don't know! I never know!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: The question mark spins! The question mark always spins!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Ooh, mystery! My favourite flavour of dread!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Last spin of the night! Make it count! Make it COUNT!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: One spin left! The Network is leaning in! I can hear it breathing!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Final spin! Whatever happens, I will remember you fondly! Briefly!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: This is it! The last one! No pressure! Some pressure! All the pressure!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Scratch it! Scratch it! Underneath is a surprise! Underneath is always a surprise!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Ooh, a scratcher! Don't scratch too deep! Things live in there!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Scratch, scratch, scratch! Like the noises in the walls!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Sold! It will be missed! It will find its way back! They always do!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Goodbye, little trinket! Don't look at it! Don't let it see you go!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: A sale! The prop room thanks you! The prop room is hungry again!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: A deal with the Producer! How exciting! How binding!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: You shook on it! Well — you would have! If you could move your arms!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Ooh, the fine print is moving! That means it likes you!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: You hung up on the Producer! Brave! Brave and brief!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Click! Oh, he's going to remember that! He remembers everything!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: No deal! The Network respects your choice! The Network writes it down!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: ENDLESS! The show goes on! The show ALWAYS goes on!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Overtime! Nobody has ever gone into overtime! Nobody has ever come back from it!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: You want MORE? Oh, the Network is blushing! Static, mostly!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: And that's our show! Same time tomorrow! Different contestant!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Goodnight, everybody! Goodnight, contestant! Goodnight, floor!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: We'll be right back after these messages! You won't!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Right on the line! The wheel couldn't decide! Neither could I!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Neighbors! Half of this, half of that! Like my face!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Splitting the difference! The flapper is sweating! Flappers can't sweat!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: HAT TRICK! Three in a row! Somebody give this contestant a hat!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Three cash in a row! The tokens! The tokens are raining! Indoors!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Dead Air! Starring you! Live, from the only studio left!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Stay tuned! You're next! You were always next!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Deadline one! A little debt, a big wheel, and you! What a night!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Deadline two! The Network is pleased! The Network wants more!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Deadline three! The debt is growing! Grow with it!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Deadline four! It's sweeps week! Smile! Your face is in every living room left!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Deadline five! Halfway there! Halfway where! Don't ask!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Deadline six! The audience has stopped breathing! They've stopped needing to!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Deadline seven! So close! The floor can taste it!

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Deadline eight! The final deadline! Sweeps again! Win this and you're FREE! Ha-ha! Probably!

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Producer here. Big fan. Bigger offer.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Don't hang up. Nobody hangs up on me. Well. Some people. Once.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Good news! I have two deals and only one of them is a trap. Probably.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: You're doing great. The numbers are... numbers. Let's talk.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Hello? Hello. I can hear you breathing, it's fine, everybody breathes.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: The Network asked me to check in. The Network is very caring.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: DEAD AIR. Do you know what DEAD AIR costs us? I do. Let me help.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Wow. Wow wow wow. Okay. Okay. I have an idea. Two ideas.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: That's going in the blooper reel. Unless... you and I come to an arrangement.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Pleasure doing business. The Network thanks you.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Smart. Very smart. I'll have legal send over the rest of you.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Done. Don't read the contract. Nobody reads the contract.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Fine. Fine! I'll remember this.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: You're hanging up on me? On ME? Enjoy the floor.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Okay. Okay. We'll talk again. We always talk again.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Eight hundred dollars, friend. Cash. Today. All I need is one more little black slice on that wheel. Tiny. You'll hardly see it.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Those Duds are embarrassing us on air. I'll have them repainted as cash tonight. The paint crew works slow, so you'll lose a little time.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: I've got something in the prop room with your name on it. Literally — we engraved it years ago. The Network will want a little extra, of course.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Six shiny Tokens. I just need you to sign here, acknowledging the Network's right to a modest... administrative slice.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Gold leaf on every dollar sign. Gorgeous. Very telegenic. Of course, the black slices will want to feel included.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Two Jackpots. Imagine it. I'll just need the trinket on the far left of your shelf. Call it a deposit. A permanent one.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Overtime! Three extra spins next show. The union won't like it. The Network will bill you for the union.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: I'll double whatever's in that safe of yours. Up to fifteen hundred. All I ask is your little Token collection. You weren't using them. Were you?

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Free scratch cards! As many as your pockets hold. They came from a wedge we had to retire. It still moves around at night.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: I can take a Bankrupt off your wheel. Just like that. The inner ring will need something in return. Nothing. Literally, a nothing.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: A ×3 on the little ring. Very exciting for the viewers. They also enjoy a Bankrupt. They enjoy those most of all.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Fifteen hundred dollars. Right now. The next payment goes up a bit, but that's next week's problem, and next week is a long way off for someone in your chair.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Your Jackpot is so thin. Practically a rumour. Three hundred dollars and our carpenter will fatten it right up.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: A gift. No strings. Well — some strings. They're attached to the gift, not to you. Mostly.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: I know a guy with a saw. Every Bankrupt, five degrees thinner. He charges in Tokens. Four of them. He likes the way they jingle.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: An Overtime wedge, installed tonight. The installers will leave a Tax wedge behind. They always leave something behind.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Your small bills are boring the audience. Let's make them... interesting.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Twenty-five more dollars on every Cash wedge. Forever. For that kind of generosity I'll need one more black slice. Forever.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: The Prize Cabinet owes me a favour. Three of them. They cost you two hundred dollars — the favours, not the cabinet.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Insurance! Every contestant should have it. Two policies, two hundred fifty dollars. The fine print is in a language we invented.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Tokens are just plastic, friend. I'll buy every one off you at a hundred dollars apiece. Cash talks. Plastic just clacks.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Two more spins next show. Three Tokens. That's the whole deal. I'm being nice tonight. Don't get used to it.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: That little zero on the inner ring. I can make it disappear. Time disappears with it — three spins' worth.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Two new wedges: one that steals from you, and one that saves you from yourself. Balance. The Network loves balance.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Repetition is comedy. ECHOs pay triple, for the rest of your contract. The Network will charge a modest syndication fee.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Why start cold? Every Deadline, your Streak will begin at ×1.5. The Bankrupts will hear about this and get jealous. Three degrees jealous.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: I know people at the Revenue. Two hundred dollars and your Vault becomes... invisible to them. Forever. Forever is a long time in here.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Let me take one of your little treasures off your hands. Randomly. In exchange, a rare one. Rarely does anyone say no. Rarely does anyone get to.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Two Vault Keys. Hang them on the safe. Nothing bad can happen twice. The Network will add a little something to the bill for the locksmith.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: A Charge wedge, freshly wired. Nobody's been electrocuted in weeks. You'll just need to give up a respin. They're the same colour, nobody will notice.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Ooh. OOH. That was a lot of money. Listen — the audience didn't see it. I can put half of it back in your Vault. The Network will want this payment a touch heavier.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Don't you dare leave the chair. Three more spins, right now, on the house. The house will also be adding a Bankrupt. The house is like that.

lines.speaker: producer
lines.text: Money's gone, but memories are forever. I'll turn that lovely memory into Tokens. One for every hundred you lost. Keep your chin up. Keep your chin.

lines.speaker: secret
lines.text: Don't talk. Just listen. I'm not the Producer, and this line isn't here.

lines.speaker: secret
lines.text: Don't thank me. Just keep spinning. Something underneath you just came loose.

lines.speaker: secret
lines.text: (a whisper) Don't say my name. They'll hear. I sat in that chair before you. I know where the Network keeps its ledger. I can tear out your next page — but they'll take your things. Everything on the shelf.

lines.speaker: secret
lines.text: (static) The trapdoor has a lever under the chair. Left of the bolt. I found it too late. Take it. And take my winnings — I won't need them where I am.

lines.speaker: secret
lines.text: (breathing) Cut the feed. The black slices only work when the cameras are rolling. Turn them into dead air. The host will stop smiling. Let him.

lines.speaker: secret
lines.text: (a long pause) You want to know what the Network is? Pick up the cards on the floor by the camera. Read them in order. Here — for your trouble.

lines.speaker: archive
lines.text: CALL TIME 6:00 PM. CONTESTANT: TBD. HOST: CONFIRMED. AUDIENCE: CONFIRMED (DO NOT FEED). WHEEL: OILED. FLOOR: TESTED.

lines.speaker: archive
lines.text: To all staff — our numbers are flat. We need more tension. Effective immediately, the trapdoor is live. Nobody needs to know it was ever not live. — Programming

lines.speaker: archive
lines.text: The Talent agrees to remain cheerful in perpetuity. "Perpetuity" is defined as the period beginning on the signing date and ending never. The Talent has initialled every page with a thumbprint. The Talent did not have thumbs at the time.

lines.speaker: archive
lines.text: Please remain seated for the duration of the broadcast. The duration of the broadcast has been extended. Please remain seated.
